subject: Re: CloudFrame POC timing — runway extension request
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudframe.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 10:14:00 +0000
Subject: POC hit unexpected integration issue — asking for runway/top-up

Hi Ben,

Quick update from our engineering team: during the adapter test this morning our tokenization step is failing intermittently when payloads exceed ~12k chars. That’s blocked the final integration smoke tests and means we won’t be able to complete the POC demo next week.

This is not something we can push past our internal QA window — we need another 2 weeks of runway to finish the connector work. Given the timeline slip, can Redwood approve a short trial extension (2 weeks) and a small sandbox credit top-up so our devs can run the expanded test matrix?

I’ve attached the build log and a short summary from the engineer. We’re also ready to sign an updated SOW if you need it.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Director of Platform Integrations
CloudFrame

Attachments: 1) build_log_0912.txt (text) 2) integration_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudframe.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 13:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC hit unexpected integration issue — asking for runway/top-up

Hey Aisha — thanks for the heads up and the logs. Sorry to hear the connector is hitting that tokenization edge.

Looping in Marissa (CS) and Karthik (solutions) to scope the ask and get an engineering read. On our side we can usually grant a two-week sandbox extension and an incremental credits top-up for blocked POCs, but I’ll need procurement sign-off on any SOW change.

Quick asks so we can move fast:
- Karthik, can you confirm whether this is a tokenization/encoding issue vs. payload shaping?
- Aisha, do you have a preferred PO process or will procurement send a PO after we confirm amounts?

If it helps, Marissa can propose a short amendment to the SOW and an interim credit grant while the PO completes.

Ben
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: sow_template_amend_v1.docx (placeholder)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@cloudframe.io>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC hit unexpected integration issue — asking for runway/top-up

Ben / Marissa — quick technical read:

I pulled the build_log_0912.txt Aisha attached. The failure pattern looks like a mismatch in encoding handling at the connector boundary — specifically when payloads combine multi-byte characters with long JSON strings we see the tokenizer drop tokens intermittently, which cascades into the inference request error.

Workaround & ETA:
- Short-term: truncate/paginate payloads on the client (1–2 days).
- Medium-term: we'll ship a connector patch that normalizes encoding and adds a preprocessing guard (4–7 business days).

If CloudFrame can run a set of smaller-batch tests (I can provide a script), we can unblock most of the demo flows in ~48 hours. If they prefer to keep the same test matrix, we should plan for the 1-week dev push and then another week for QA -> total 2 weeks.

I attached an excerpt of the error lines I pulled.

—Karthik
Solutions Engineer, Redwood

Attachment: error_log_snippet.txt
